mirror_contract.rule: The repository is the only semantic and versioning source; the live website download surface mirrors only current portable generations.
update_procedure: Update the canonical current portable in Moon-Source first.
Copy the exact canonical UTF-8 bytes to the mapped current LUAHELENA moonsource/downloads path on a branch.
Remove any superseded mirror file from the live website download tree.
Run scripts/check_mirror_sync.py against the remote mirror or a local LUAHELENA checkout.
Open and review a website pull request; merge only after SHA-256 equality and production-surface review.
mirror_contract.current_rebase_note: Chat–Work V3 is the current canonical protocol. Superseded V2 files are removed from the live Moon-Source and LUAHELENA trees; historical V2 content remains recoverable through Git history. Current portable mirrors remain exact byte copies of their canonical current files.
